title: 複習十一
teacherNotes: Teacher-approved review migration module R011; pair with R012. Milestone L120; coverage L091-L120; allowed-character ceiling through L120 only. Review modules introduce no new characters and have no zhuyin or charAudio.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: A clear children's picture-book scene with several children playing ball together on a school playground or open play area. Show at least four children so 好幾個 is visually clear. The children are actively playing with one ball; no adults are the focus. Keep the recurring protagonist girl visible as one of the children or watching nearby.

Use the fixed recurring sporty boy identity for 他, not a generic boy. The sporty boy is playing a simple ball game and has clearly scored many points. Show a small child-friendly scoreboard or score cards with many points marked, and the sporty boy happily holding or hitting the ball. Make 他 visually refer to the recurring sporty boy, not the protagonist girl.

A ball bat has fallen onto green grass. The bat should be clearly on the grass, not in a child's hand. Keep the scene simple: grass, the bat, and possibly a ball nearby. Do not make the bat look like a pencil or stick.
A child's hat is falling off from their head. Show the hat just above or beside the child's head in mid-fall, with the child looking surprised. The relation between 頭上 and 帽子 must be visually clear.

The recurring protagonist girl is outside looking up. A small bird is flying across the sky above her. Make 外面 clear with outdoor ground, sky, and open space. The bird should be in the sky, not inside a house or on a tree.
